config.task_description: Whole-body multi-organ segmentation of CT into 117 anatomical structures (TotalSegmentator v2 label scheme). Final task score = macro-mean Dice across the 117 foreground classes, averaged only over classes with non-empty ground-truth per patient. The 117 target classes span abdominal organs, thoracic structures, vertebrae C1-S1, ribs L1-12 / R1-12, limb bones, vessels, and skeletal muscle.
